title: Network refreshing can re-order the list items just before you were about to click on one of them
line: The Networks list no longer reshuffles under your pointer when a scan updates it; it re-sorts once the pointer leaves the list.
explanation: The applet's AppletProxyModel sorts with dynamicSortFilter on, so every signal-strength change or new access point from a scan re-sorted the list immediately, even while the pointer rested on a row. The row under the pointer could change just before a click, with no warning. AppletProxyModel gains a keepOrder property that turns dynamic sorting off (new networks are appended at the end) and re-filters and re-sorts when it is turned off again; a connection state change still re-sorts at once. The applet binds keepOrder to a HoverHandler on the connection list.

commits.message:
applet: Keep the network list order while the pointer is over it

Scans update signal strengths and add networks all the time, so the list
re-sorted right under the pointer and a click could hit another network.
The order is now held while hovered, except when a connection changes.

BUG: 513116

media.caption: Before: pointer on Office (left); a scan changes two signals and the list re-sorts under it, the pointer is now on Neighbour (right).
After: pointer on Neighbour (left); a scan changes three signals, only the icons update and the order stays (middle); the pointer leaves the list and it re-sorts (right).
